name: BomaAreaCalculator
tagline: Usable to rentable for every suite – BOMA 2017 load factors, common area allocation and lease variance in one Power Apps app.
description: A complete BOMA area measurement app for landlords, lease administrators and measurement surveyors: keep one register of every measured space (suites, floor service, building service and amenity areas, vertical penetrations, excluded areas) and get usable and rentable areas, floor and building R/U ratios and load factors, the common-area share of every tenant, lease variances with their rent impact, an optional load-factor cap, a measure → verify → approve workflow with a four-eyes rule and floor certification, printable area schedules and a what-if view. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: BOMA 2017 Office floor + building allocation, or a single building load factor
Floor R/U, building ratio, load factor and composition per floor
Usable → rentable waterfall per suite with floor and building shares
Lease variance with tolerance, red/amber flags and rent impact a year
Measure → verify → approve with four-eyes rule, return and reopen
Certify floor and printable area schedule (AreaScheduleText)
Split suite (demising) and what-if scenarios (cap, method, amenity changes)
Search, 11 quick filters, grouping, bulk verify/approve, CSV export, undo
Demo mode with 56 fictional spaces in two buildings
Phone layout from 320 px, keyboard floor navigation, ARIA labels
pack: Niray Real Estate & Facilities PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: BomaAreaCalculator data-set, BomaAreaCalculatorPortal field)
